description: This file defines a React functional component for confirming sign-out from other sessions/devices in a web application. It includes UI elements for prompting the user and handling actions to revoke sessions.

methods.name: ConfirmOtherSessionsSignOut
methods.description: A React component that renders a dialog to confirm signing out of other sessions.

methods.name: closeDialog
methods.description: Closes the dialog by updating viewControllerManager state.

methods.name: confirm
methods.description: Revokes all other sessions and displays an alert upon success.
